Bedan aspiration in Filipino: 'alam niya na, nagtapos ako sa Mapa High na katapat lang ng San Beda, and from where I envied the San Beda boys who were being chased by the collegialas of the College of the Holy Spirit, La Consolacion and Centro Escolar'; was heading to Mendiola to enroll in San Beda; 'natapilok po ako... nasalo ako ni Dr. Jovito R. Salonga, ang decano ng FEU Institute of Law'

Two missed Bedan CJs: (1) Ave Cruz -- in 1986, offered SC seat by President Cory Aquino; rejected it to be Deputy Prime Minister under Salvador Laurel; (2) Rene Saguisag -- 'then Executive Secretary Joker Arroyo handed him his signed appointment to the Supreme Court in January 1987. Pero mahiyain po si Rene, likas na hindi mahilig.' -- if either had accepted, there would have been no CJs Davide, Puno or Panganiban

Justice Jose Catral Mendoza: 'naturally humble and intelligent Bedans'; upon learning of his appointment: 'Some things do happen beyond one's own planning and imagining. This appointment is one of them. I thought that I would be retiring as an Associate Justice of the Court of Appeals in a year's time. But fate carried me along directions I never envisioned even in my dreams. And for this life's surprise, for this appointment in particular, I call it a miracle, leaving me the feeling of awe and wonder.'

Constitutional qualifications: proven competence, integrity, probity and independence; Justice Mendoza possesses all; but what struck CJP most is 'his faith in the Almighty to whom he dedicates all he is and all he does, the discipline by which he lives his life'
Faith background: two brothers are Catholic priests; three others are current or retired members of the Philippine Air Force ('where discipline is the daily routine')

First message to SC officials and employees: 'my ardent prayer that the Lord may grant me: the serenity to accept the things I cannot change, the courage to change the things I can, and the wisdom to know the difference' (Reinhold Niebuhr prayer)

Seven fruitful years: will serve before retiring on August 17, 2017; 'with such prayer to begin with and with determination and dedication, Justice Mendoza shall be remembered in the history of the Supreme Court'

stances.claim: The two men responsible for the absence of a native San Beda CJ are Ave Cruz and Rene Saguisag -- both of whom declined SC appointments (1986 and 1987 respectively). Had either accepted, there would have been no Chief Justices Davide, Puno or Panganiban. CJP explicitly includes himself among those who would not have existed as CJ -- and delivers this in Filipino for the Bedan audience.
stances.rhetorical_move: Tagalog-counterfactual-gratitude: the same three-non-existent-CJs argument but delivered in Filipino to a San Beda audience, with Rene Saguisag added as a second missed opportunity
stances.confidence: asserted as the historical record with evident affection

stances.claim: Justice Mendoza's characterization of his own SC appointment as 'a miracle, leaving me the feeling of awe and wonder' -- and his immediate invocation of the Niebuhr serenity-courage-wisdom prayer as his first message to the Court -- are the defining evidence of the humility and intelligence that CJP says characterize Bedans ('magpapakumbaba at matatalino').
stances.rhetorical_move: honoree's-own-words-as-proof: Mendoza's miracle-and-awe response as the evidence that validates CJP's claim about Bedan character
stances.confidence: asserted through direct quotation of the honoree's own statement

notable_anecdotes: Natapilok at FEU (in Filipino): CJP was heading to Mendiola to enroll at San Beda when 'natapilok po ako. Mabuti na lang nasalo ako ni Dr. Jovito R. Salonga, ang decano ng FEU Institute of Law at hindi ako nasugatan o napilayan. Kaya naman hindi ko napahindian ang kanyang alok na sa FEU na lang ako mag-enrol.' -- the most whimsical version of the Salonga-interception story, delivered entirely in Filipino.

Rene Saguisag's mahiyain declination: 'then Executive Secretary Joker Arroyo handed him his signed appointment to the Supreme Court in January 1987. Pero mahiyain po si Rene, likas na hindi mahilig.' -- the most succinct and humorous account of a missed judicial appointment in the corpus.

one_paragraph_summary: Delivered May 6, 2010 as the Special Guest of Honor address at an SBLAA gathering honoring newly appointed SC Justice Jose Catral Mendoza -- invited by Ave Cruz -- this speech by CJP opens in Filipino: he was honorary SBLAA member since November 15, 2006 ('I thought Ave was just humoring me and wanted to massage my ego'); his Bedan aspiration dated from Mapa High School days opposite San Beda, when 'he envied the San Beda boys being chased by the collegialas of the College of the Holy Spirit, La Consolacion and Centro Escolar'; he was heading to San Beda to enroll when 'natapilok po ako -- mabuti na lang nasalo ako ni Dr. Jovito R. Salonga, ang decano ng FEU Institute of Law.' The reason San Beda has no native CJ is 'the fault of Ave Cruz and Rene Saguisag': Ave declined Cory Aquino's SC offer in 1986 to be Deputy PM under Laurel; Rene Saguisag was handed a signed SC appointment by Executive Secretary Joker Arroyo in January 1987 but 'mahiyain po si Rene, likas na hindi mahilig'; 'kung tinanggap ni Ave o ni Rene ang alok ni Pangulong Cory, eh di sana hindi nagkaruon ng Chief Justice Hilario G. Davide, Jr., Chief Justice Reynato S. Puno at Chief Justice Artemio V. Panganiban.' The tribute to Justice Mendoza: upon receiving his appointment, Mendoza said 'Some things do happen beyond one's own planning and imagining... fate carried me along directions I never envisioned even in my dreams... I call it a miracle, leaving me the feeling of awe and wonder.' He possesses the four constitutional desiderata (competence, integrity, probity, independence), but what struck CJP most is his faith in the Almighty; two brothers are Catholic priests, three are Philippine Air Force officers ('where discipline is the daily routine'); his first message to the SC was the Niebuhr serenity-courage-wisdom prayer; he will serve seven fruitful years before retiring August 17, 2017. CJP: 'Mga Kaibigan, talaga pong likas na magpapakumbaba at matalino ang mga taga San Beda.'
